list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.query: SELECT zone_name AS __text, zone_id AS __value FROM taxi_zones ORDER BY zone_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.centroid_lat AS latitude, z.centroid_lon AS longitude, z.zone_name AS name, SUM(h.pickup_count) AS pickups FROM hourly_demand h JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.zone_id = h.zone_id WHERE h.time_bucket BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY z.zone_id, z.centroid_lat, z.centroid_lon, z.zone_name HAVING SUM(h.pickup_count) > 0
SELECT $__timeGroup(time_bucket, '1h') AS time, SUM(pickup_count) AS pickups FROM hourly_demand WHERE $__timeFilter(time_bucket) AND ($zone = 0 OR zone_id = $zone) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT z.borough, SUM(h.pickup_count) AS pickups FROM hourly_demand h JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.zone_id = h.zone_id WHERE $__timeFilter(h.time_bucket) GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY pickups DESC

panels.title: Hotspot Alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.detected_at AS time, z.zone_name, z.borough, a.demand_current, a.demand_baseline, ROUND(a.ratio::numeric, 2) AS ratio, a.severity FROM hotspot_alerts a JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.zone_id = a.zone_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.detected_at) ORDER BY a.detected_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Hotspots where hourly demand >= 2x the zone's own baseline (mean hourly pickups, floor 1.0). Severity: 2.0-3.0 = warning, >=3.0 = critical. Populated by batch reconstruction of the 2x rule over historical hourly_demand; the live Spark aggregation path (Phase 3 Block 4) remains future work.

panels.title: Forecast vs Actual

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time_bucket, '1h') AS time, SUM(pickup_count) AS actual FROM hourly_demand WHERE $__timeFilter(time_bucket) AND ($zone = 0 OR zone_id = $zone) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(forecast_time, '1h') AS time, SUM(predicted_demand) AS predicted FROM forecast_results WHERE $__timeFilter(forecast_time) AND ($zone = 0 OR zone_id = $zone) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Forecast (ARIMA/ETS) vs actual demand. Covers the top-10 demand zones modelled in Phase 4 (TriBeCa, West Chelsea/Hudson Yards, JFK, East New York, East Village, LaGuardia, Midtown Center, Times Sq, East Chelsea, Crown Heights North). Other zones show 'No data' by design.

targets.rawSql: SELECT zo.zone_name AS origin, zd.zone_name AS destination, SUM(f.trip_count) AS trips, ROUND(MAX(f.betweenness)::numeric, 4) AS max_betweenness FROM network_flows f JOIN taxi_zones zo ON zo.zone_id = f.origin_zone_id JOIN taxi_zones zd ON zd.zone_id = f.dest_zone_id WHERE $__timeFilter(f.time_window) GROUP BY zo.zone_name, zd.zone_name ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT $__timeGroup(time_bucket, '1h') AS time, SUM(pickup_count) AS demand, AVG(avg_temperature) AS temp_c, AVG(precipitation_mm) AS precip_mm FROM hourly_demand WHERE $__timeFilter(time_bucket) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: System Health — DB Connections & Table Freshness

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'trip_events' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows, MAX(pickup_datetime) AS latest FROM trip_events UNION ALL SELECT 'hourly_demand', COUNT(*), MAX(time_bucket) FROM hourly_demand UNION ALL SELECT 'forecast_results', COUNT(*), MAX(forecast_time) FROM forecast_results UNION ALL SELECT 'spatial_statistics', COUNT(*), MAX(analysis_time) FROM spatial_statistics UNION ALL SELECT 'temporal_anomalies', COUNT(*), MAX(detected_at) FROM temporal_anomalies UNION ALL SELECT 'network_flows', COUNT(*), MAX(time_window) FROM network_flows ORDER BY table_name

SELECT z.centroid_lat AS latitude, z.centroid_lon AS longitude, z.zone_name AS name, s.gi_star_z, s.lisa_cluster, s.is_significant_hotspot FROM spatial_statistics s JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.zone_id = s.zone_id WHERE s.analysis_time = (SELECT MAX(analysis_time) FROM spatial_statistics)

SELECT t.detected_at AS time, z.zone_name, t.anomaly_type, ROUND(t.anomaly_score::numeric, 3) AS score, t.demand_value, t.expected_value FROM temporal_anomalies t JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.zone_id = t.zone_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.detected_at) AND t.is_anomaly = true ORDER BY t.detected_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Trend Decomposition (Prophet)

targets.rawSql: SELECT analysis_time AS time, trend_value AS trend, seasonal_weekly AS weekly_seasonality FROM trend_decomposition WHERE $__timeFilter(analysis_time) AND ($zone = 0 OR zone_id = $zone) ORDER BY analysis_time

panels.description: Prophet trend & weekly-seasonality decomposition. Covers the top-10 demand zones modelled in Phase 4 (TriBeCa, West Chelsea/Hudson Yards, JFK, East New York, East Village, LaGuardia, Midtown Center, Times Sq, East Chelsea, Crown Heights North). Other zones show 'No data' by design.
